label: End-of-episode D2: chose a1, reached S1 (common), after an unrewarded rare trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only in the last 10 trials of an episode (ep_trial 90-99, mostly 95+), when the model value is in its lowest bin (value < ~5, which tracks the approaching episode end). Almost all mass (98%) falls on trials where the agent chose a1 and reached S1 (a common transition). It is strongly enriched when the previous trial went unrewarded (98% of mass) and was a rare transition (86%), i.e. the agent stayed with a1 after a rare-unrewarded a1->S2 trial and now sees S1. Activations are largest on the final trials (ep_trial 98-99). It never fires at D1 or GO, on a2/S2 trials (a2 or S2 accounts for under 4% of mass), or before trial 90. All variables in the predicate are observable at D2 (value is the model output). Dev F1 is 0.65 with mass recall 0.80: many late a1->S1 trials that fit the pattern are still silent, so the predicate does not capture what sets the threshold.
